{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("Columns:", data.columns.tolist())
print("First few rows:\n", data.head())

# Check for sentinel values and anomalies
print("\nUnique values in customer_age:", data['customer_age'].unique())
print("Count of -1 in customer_age:", (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue: is it string? Any commas?
print("\nSample of revenue column:", data['revenue'].head().tolist())
print("Is revenue string?", data['revenue'].dtype == 'object')

# Check for QA orders and refunded orders
print("\nQA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", (data['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())
print("Refunded orders:", (data['status'] == 'refunded').sum())"}
